title: ID0423769-DC/Si-D/FI-[Y2 / R4 313038785010]-Lieksa converter E17
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Converter is in error E17 and reboot doesn't fix the issue.
Solution:
Action:
RC-FI will continue by checking CAN connector and if needed, will replace converter unit. Dispenser roll cross ends will be replaced if needed (sharp edges)
